modifications: Define real consumer-owned native/Safari journeys and nonempty observable assertions through official tools.
Keep required scenarios/devices and actual build identity explicit; no screenshot-only or launch-only pass.
Preserve upstream MIT attribution and per-file original/adapted byte digests.
required_tools: Apple Xcode MCP via xcrun mcpbridge for supported interactive work

verification.scope: Local payload bytes, licenses, references, shell parsing and metadata projection only; not native/application/formal execution, discovery or protected CI.
verification.raw_quick_validate: Rejected standard top-level compatibility; temporary projection omits only that field. Distributed field and validator remain unchanged.

reproducible_payload_audit.setup: Use separate clean checkouts: the exact tool commit and this package source commit. These independent draft branches are not merged.
reproducible_payload_audit.scope: Worktree inventory/hash/license consistency only; not Git tracking or source authentication.

verification.shared_ci_dependency: https://github.com/bajor/github-workflows/pull/9 must be approved/deployed separately and current skill heads rerun; present phone-scanner failure is not waived.

integrity.scope: All payload files except provenance.json. Self-hashes detect accidental drift only; trusted complete-tree pin and consumer lock are future infrastructure, not demonstrated here.
